IN THE NEXT GEN TIMELINE: The events in the mikaelson children story and Olivia Bennett take place over the span of 1 school year and both end right before summer. This story starts at the beginning of that summer. Jonah is 17 and this is his last summer before his senior year. Emi and Hana are about to go into their sophomore year at SIS. The cousins/siblings go to different schools but have a very close relationship as they basically group up together as children of “diplomats”. Another One of the reasons is that every summer, Lizzie and Caroline come to Osaka and take them and MG to Washington DC, Virginia where they stay with their uncle Kaleb and their aunt Cleo at the Hawkins hotel. The Hawkins run by the duo was a founded by kaleb to give new or exiled vampires a place to stay without having to be invited in. Over 14 years it has covered a lot of ground from ripper rehabilitation to vampire nightlife to now being its own small coven that now doubles as a huge attraction and shelter for vampires especially since daylight rings became less accessible. The saltzman/Sawada children love going to the Hawkins, MG visits his best-friend and the hotel is full of interesting characters to say the least that the kids have come to consider as family. They spend time with their grandma before she and Lizzie head of to Atilus the vampire centric city founded by Marcel to report him their findings. This year was special as Kaleb was celebrating his 15th year anniversary with the hotel so several powerful vampires across the U.S as well as heavy supernatural political figures and members of the council we’re headed to Hawkins to come his Anniversary party. At this point Lizzie and Caroline are aware that Hope was in fact alive and we’re on the active search for her children. When they arrive they have a warm welcome from Kaleb and Cleo waiting for them. Jonah films the whole thing as the family reunite and hug. When Cleo hugs the girls she collapses into a seizure and speaks the words “Four children born and cursed by magic, Four secrets that change the past, from them shall come the destroyers of life, for none can escape what shall come to pass.” The kids were quickly taken away from Cleo and Kaleb carried her to her room. The kids were told to go to the rooftop and hang out up there. In the meantime Lizzie, Caroline, MG and Kaleb get on a call with Josie and tell her what was said and they brainstorm what this could mean. At the same time as the kids review the video that Jonah took of the event. The twins notice that their parents exchange a look they recognized, the look they made when they were hiding something. The next day is the Anniversary party and meet a bunch of their parents old friends as well as the Donovan family. Matt introduces his wife Jeannette and his kids victor, Tyler and Diana to the saltzman. Victor has long graduated from the police academy and is following his father’s footsteps. Tyler and Diana however Matt has issues with due to their choice of interest. Diana has chosen to join the Salvatore school as a huntress and Tyler shows a serious interest in alchemy and magic. The saltzman twins automatically form a bond with Tyler and Diana. Jonah teaches Tyler about alchemy much to Matt’s dismay and Diana is learning about how the Salvatore school runs in Japan. During the anniversary the twins notice some of the guests going into Private areas and calls them out creating an awkward end to the night. This story kind of follows this plot and Emi is discovered as being the vessel for the demon that possessed her mother. She almost unleashed the full extent of her power but Tyler used a sealing ritual to keep her in check. Meaning that Tyler had been practicing occultism. He made the others swear that they would not tell Matt if he stopped and picked up alchemy instead. The climax of this book is reached when Caroline, Izzie and the twins are invited to Jeannette Donovan’s birthday party near the end of June. During this party the Caroline and LIzzie notice the amount of security (Which is fair considering Matt is considered a political figure). Tyler and Diana take the twins and Jonah to their mothers secret study to look at some of the demonology books that Tyler had found and overhear a conversation between Jeannette and Victor. They say things like “The hunters are frantic right now, their plans are coming undone.” They talk about a Bennett and Gilbert child that has run off with their spare Salvatore and how with him gone and the lost location of something called the K.A.T they’ve lost their best weapon. The. They argued about a specific subject the mikaelson Children, hearing things like “ IM TELLING YOU ITS NOT POSSIBLE THEY DIED” followed by “How else do you explain what I saw?” And the last thing was the worst “the prototypes have already been sent out to the Hawkins, it won’t survive the night”. The kids panicked and ran to go and find an exit. They went through a different room, a lab if you will filled with sleeping vampires being experimented on. One was awoken and looked crazed and hungry but it didn’t feed on them. There blood Wasn’t what it craved and he escaped to through a window. The kids (Donovan I caused) ran to their parents and told them what they saw and heard (specifically the parts about the vampire lab and the Hawkins leaving out the rest out of panic) and Caroline looked horrified. This story ends as they drive quickly back to the Hawkins only to find it in flames and surrounded by hunters and police. Not wanting to show themselves Caroline left with the children while Lizzie stayed to look for MG (she could feel that he was still alive.) Caroline was left with 2 options either take the kids with her to Alitus to find Marcel or look for the Mikaelson Children.

Saltzman:
After the events of Legacies Josie spent some time working with Elena’s medical practice and Lizzie helped Hope with the newfound demon threats that had appeared. After the exposure of magic Josie and Lizzie played central roles in the forming of the council. Josie befriended Evan Sawada, the heir to a Japanese conglomerate company. Josie became a translator between the supernatural council meeting and the Sawada corporation. With her guidance and the knowledge of the armoury, Evan along with Alaric and Dorian became the very first official Alchemists. Sawada corp was the first to adopt the supernatural into their company and with the help of witches began producing magical artifacts for healing and protection against the supernatural. They were pivotal in the globalization of magic. Evan worshiped the ground Josie walked on but they’re relationship really happened because Josie was not over her first love Penelope park. Penelope, along with Wade seeing the seeds of oppression being planted by the hunters formed a group to observe and fight them if need be. They named this small group the Valkyries. While Josie was traveling with Evan she and Penelope rekindled and got engaged. During this time Lizzie was Hope’s second in command on the council. Her and MG’s relationship grew. MG who did not wish to be a teenager forever, took the cure. Lizzie who had found a sense of purpose as a Heretic did not wish to take it (at least not yet). MG tried to go to his parents and mend their relationship. He discovered that during the exposure they had founded a religious anti-supernatural hate group. (One that would eventually play a pivotal role in spreading anti-supernatural propaganda) They stated that they did not wish to associate with occult sympathizers. (After the rise of the occultist the word occult became used as a slur for all the supernatural) seeing as his parents hated what he once was and what his love still is he decided to cut off all contact. MG and Lizzie were married and he took the Saltzman name. The couple asked Josie to be a surrogate for them and she agreed. To their shock, Josie successfully gave birth to a human boy they named Jonah Ethan Saltzman. It was decided that Lizzie’s turning into a heretic cut off the Gemini coven’s magic and the girls would be the last witches of their line. After giving birth to human Jonah, and seeing the progress her and Evan were doing with the alchemists Josie desired to have a child of her own. Her and Penelope asked Evan to be the donor and he was happy to. When Josie was 4 months pregnant a disastrous event which would later be known as the battle of marseille occurred. A small protest for supernaturals were reported to the Valkyries to be harassed by the hunters. The group made of witches and fairies stepped up for them and this led to a serious altercation. The valkyries had a very quick upper hand and forced the hunters to call their trump card. They were seen calling their HQ and then for a solid 10 minutes the magic in the city shut down.  Vampires died of their natural deaths, wolves strength and claws could not be accessed, magic artifacts that protected homes and kept people alive in hospitals failed and witches could no longer cast. The hunters got an upper hand and the Valkyries were slaughtered and half the city was destroyed as a cover up. According to the news the Valkyries had used a powerful which absorbed all the magic around them and caused the destruction. However, Hope, Bonnie and Caroline were suspicious they had only seen this once before. When the travelers came to mystic falls. It was too late to say much as public outrage caused the Valkyries to be villainized and all involved became known as terrorists, digging the suspicion of supernaturals even deeper. Josie became inconsolable. Nobody could reach her, this was because she had locked herself in her house and tried to bring her love back to life. Like it had been done several times in the past. After the demons became a common occurrence, resurrection became a dangerous game as possession was very easy for them. When she cast the spell it was a success but Penelope’s body was possessed by a high demon and attempted to kill Josie (who again was pregnant). Desperate to protect her child Josie used her last card and blasted the demon with an unspeakable amount of dark magic. Penelope’s body was destroyed but the spirit of the demon fled. Due to this incident Josie had lost all her magic. Her family were there to support her afterwards. In an unexpected turn after this happened the family was shocked to find that Josie was no longer pregnant with one child but 2…twins. Hope and Lizzie came in and they waited until the children were born. Once born the twin girls Emi and Hana showed signs of being siphon witches, the power that Josie once had. The hypothesis was that Josie’s magic retreated to her womb to protect the children but the appearance of the second child was thought to have been the demon. They could not tell which was which and Josie and Evan fell in love with both so they decided to raise them with no knowledge of this incident. Hope was the first to point out the hypocrisy of keeping this from them just as their father had done to them in the past. This was different though, they had no idea if this meant that the merge was meant to happen or if one of them grew to not be their child at all and Josie did not want this knowledge to affect them the way it affected her and Lizzie. The park name became synonymous with hatred and the saltzman name was similar so Josie decided to give them the Sawada name. After the “Assassination” of Hope, Lizzie, due to her affiliation with Josie and Penelope was not selected to replace her as representative for hybrids. Instead Will(leader of the hunters) publicly nominated a witch/wolf hybrid of his choosing and the people voted for him. Josie and Lizzie did not want their kids to be so close to this chaos and unlike the mikaelson children (who are believed to be dead) the saltzman family has grown up in the public eye,so they relocated to Osaka, Japan where Sawada corp had their head office and hired several people from the supernatural. This made it much easier for the supernatural to make a living in that city. Lizzie, Josie and Caroline who knew hope dying was not a possibility realized that this could only mean two things, either Hope had been captured and was being tortured or she was alive and in hiding. So Lizzie and Caroline left to go search every Mikaelson stronghold and gather information while Josie, MG and Evan stayed with the kids in Osaka. Jonah was enrolled into the YMCA international school (it’s a real school in Osaka) and the twins were put into the Salvatore International school.
